correctness.rationale: The invariant relation follows from z x−t y=d and the p-th-power identity. After inverting z the image is a Laurent polynomial ring in z,t,d,V since V is monic of degree p in y over k[z,z⁻¹,t,d]. The fixed fraction field is obtained by the indicated degree-p translation; A is integral over the proposed ring. The hypersurface is a domain by primitivity in U, has singular set exactly z=t=d=0 by its partials, and is normal by S2 and R1. Thus the integral fixed ring equals the presentation. The z-localization is factorial and its complement is a prime principal divisor because t^p V+d^p is primitive linear in V, so Nagata applies; hypersurface Gorensteinness is immediate. In each blowup chart the displayed proper-transform equation is saturated with respect to its exceptional variable: the resulting ring is a domain (solve the linear relation in the first two charts and use primitivity in the third) and the variable is nonzero. In the third chart a=b=0 is impossible, so a derivative in U or V is nonzero; those partials are units in the first two charts. The same check on the exceptional equation shows a smooth total divisor, even though each geometric fibre is cut out by the p-th power of a nonzero linear form in P². Ambient codimension three and exact multiplicity p give 2−p by adjunction. The Artin–Schreier generic fibre has degree p; over each point of the singular plane the fibre algebra has basis x^i y^j for 0≤i,j<p, giving length p² and violating constant rank for a finite flat map. All signs and arguments include p=2. The frozen script and recorded finite checks were inspected, not executed; they are not needed for the uniform chart proof.

value.rationale: The quotient of the named wild cyclic action is a natural test of explicit resolution in varying characteristic. The uniform single center, its smooth exceptional total space with nonreduced geometric fibres everywhere, and the exact discrepancy are joint geometric information not given by the invariant presentation alone. The degree and fibre calculation describes separately how the finite quotient fails to be flat; the usefulness does not require a classification of other actions or a minimality claim.
